frontend_policy.rule: Ne mijenjati postojeći vizualni identitet; dopuštene su funkcionalne korekcije koje ubrzavaju ili stabiliziraju front.
frontend_policy.performance_rule: Snapshot data must render before external live API attempts; heavy visual modules stay deferred through app.js idle loading.

news_publication.fallback_policy: If some sources fail but at least 80 percent are synchronized, publish valid public set with degraded status metadata.

market_data.display_rule: Use stored snapshot first with clear status; attempt browser live data second without blocking initial render.

contact.policy: Contact form may receive inquiries; sensitive legal, financial, media or official responses require human review.

required_before_public_change: news public limit must stay at 100
archive limit must stay at or below 500
status cadence must match twice daily news policy
market module must support marketGrid and coinGrid
news module must support data-category and data-filter
mail automation must remain draft_only unless explicitly approved
contact form must keep human approval rule for sensitive topics
